name: music-mod
description: /music: what macOS Music.app is playing, in one line above the prompt. A pressable play/pause glyph, track · artist · album, a progress bar with the clocks, and a pressable next-track glyph, refreshed every two seconds while shown.

refreshMs.title: Refresh interval
refreshMs.description: Milliseconds between reads of Music.app while the pane is open. 2000 by default; 500 at the least.
